name: Alport Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of family history of hematuria, renal failure, or hearing loss
Persistent microscopic hematuria starting in childhood
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss, typically affecting high frequencies
Characteristic ultrastructural changes in glomerular basement membrane on renal biopsy
Anterior lenticonus or other characteristic ocular abnormalities
Identification of pathogenic mutations in COL4A3, COL4A4, or COL4A5 genes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Persistent hematuria plus either sensorineural hearing loss or characteristic renal biopsy findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can confirm diagnosis but is not always required.

pathognomonic.notes: Usually the earliest and most consistent finding
searchTerms: blood in urine visible only under microscope
tiny amounts of blood in urine

pathognomonic.notes: Typically progressive and affects high frequencies
searchTerms: hearing loss from nerve damage both ears

pathognomonic.notes: Pathognomonic ocular abnormality in Alport syndrome

common.notes: Leads to end-stage renal disease in many patients

occasional.notes: May occur episodically, often with upper respiratory infections

rare.notes: Rare smooth muscle tumors associated with some COL4A5 mutations

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine with progressive renal failure
imaging: Renal ultrasound showing normal or small echogenic kidneys in advanced disease
Ocular slit-lamp examination revealing anterior lenticonus
Audiometry demonstrating bilateral sensorineural hearing loss
genetic: Pathogenic variants in COL4A3, COL4A4, or COL4A5 genes
X-linked inheritance pattern most common (COL4A5 mutations)
other: Renal biopsy showing irregular thickening and splitting of glomerular basement membrane on electron microscopy

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated hematuria without progressive renal failure
Thinning of glomerular basement membrane without lamellation
No hearing loss or ocular abnormalities
No progression to end-stage renal disease
Multisystem involvement including neuropathic pain and angiokeratomas

redFlags: Progressive sensorineural hearing loss in a patient with hematuria
Family history of early-onset renal failure
Presence of anterior lenticonus on ocular examination
references: Kashtan CE. Alport syndrome: Achieving clarity on the genetic and clinical spectrum. Kidney Int. 2021;99(1):42-52.

Savige J, Gregory M, Gross O, et al. Expert guidelines for the management of Alport syndrome and thin basement membrane nephropathy. J Am Soc Nephrol. 2013;24(3):364-375.
